metadata.title: Avellaneda-Stoikov BTCUSDT Futures Backtest

calibration.gamma_method: grid search maximizing net_pnl - drawdown_penalty * max_drawdown - inventory_penalty * max_abs_inventory

metadata.interpretation: Sigma is estimated from realized BTCUSDT mid-price changes, k is fitted from L2 next-snapshot crossing intensity by quote distance, and gamma is selected by a risk-adjusted backtest objective. The strategy places a multi-level quote ladder around the Avellaneda-Stoikov reservation price.
